clips.title: The story
paras: High on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff, Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem senses an unsettling surge of power flowing into the arid soils of the Barrens. To uncover the truth, he dispatches promising travelers eastward past Mulgore's gates to rendezvous with his kinsman, Tonga Runetotem, at the Crossroads. This mission marks the beginning of an investigation into the unnatural waters springing up across the sun-baked plains.

While the plains of Mulgore flourish under the watchful gaze of the Earth Mother, the vast savannas of the Barrens to the east have remained harsh, scorched, and dry for generations. Recently, however, the tauren druids meditating atop Thunder Bluff's Elder Rise have detected strange currents of energy waking deep beneath the parched plains. Life is stirring where it ought not to be, and the Cenarion Circle fears that whatever force is causing this surge may harbor hidden peril for the land and its creatures.

To investigate these strange occurrences, Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem dispatched Tonga Runetotem into the field. Recognizing that the vast wilderness holds dangers too great for one investigator alone, Hamuul enlists travelers leaving Mulgore to hasten after Tonga. Following the road east past Bloodhoof Village and through the mountain passes leads straight to the Crossroads—the dusty, bustling heart of Horde territory in the Barrens—where Tonga awaits answers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The druids of Thunder Bluff sense a strange power leaking into the Barrens, east of Mulgore.
Tonga Runetotem was sent to discover the source of this power, but we fear he will need aid.

Travel to the Barrens and speak with Tonga. He will be at the Crossroads. To reach there, take the road east out of Bloodhoof village. Enter the Barrens, then turn north when the road forks. Continue north and you will find the Crossroads.
And do not leave the road, friend, for the Barrens is a harsh land.

clips.title: Completion
paras: My brethren in Thunder Bluff were wise to send you, young adventurer. For the mystery of the Barrens is one that I alone cannot unravel.
With your aid, let us hope we can find answers to our questions.
